description: This file defines the TenantClientFactory interface in the org.eclipse.hono.client package, providing factory methods to create TenantClient instances for interacting with Hono's Tenant API. It includes static methods for creating factory instances with or without caching configurations and a method to retrieve or instantiate TenantClient objects asynchronously.

classes.name: TenantClientFactory
classes.description: A factory interface for creating TenantClient instances to interact with Hono's Tenant API.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory method to create a TenantClientFactory with an existing connection, without caching.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory method to create a TenantClientFactory with an existing connection and an optional cache provider.

methods.name: getOrCreateTenantClient
methods.description: Asynchronous method to get or create a TenantClient, returning a Future that completes with the client or an error.
